name: Modules.BLE
description:
Using Bluetooth Low Energy module is used to interact with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.

You can download the module at [appcelerator.ble](https://github.com/tidev/appcelerator.ble/releases)

- Note (IOS): Starting iOS 13, it's mandatory for developers to specify the Privacy Usage Description
  for Bluetooth by including NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription in their tiapp.xml file. Otherwise
  accessing any Core Bluetooth APIs would lead to a crash. For backward support for older iOS
  versions, NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription needs to be defined.

- If your app needs to run in background to perform certain Bluetooth-related tasks, it must declare
  that it supports a Core Bluetooth background execution mode in tiapp.xml using UIBackgroundModes key
  ``` xml
  <key>UIBackgroundModes</key>
  <array>
      [string](api:Global.String)bluetooth-central</string>
      [string](api:Global.String)bluetooth-peripheral</string>
  </array>
  ```

bluetooth-central : The app communicates with Bluetooth low energy peripherals using the Core Bluetooth framework.
bluetooth-peripheral :The app shares data using the Core Bluetooth framework.

The Apple documentation states that applications are allowed to scan while backgrounded but the
scan must specify the service types. wild card scan is not supported in the background.

Note: A detailed information about how to use module in your application, can be found with artifacts at path modules/iphone (platform)/appcelerator.ble/x.y.z (version of module)/documentation/index.html

properties.name: ADVERT_DATA_KEY_IS_CONNECTABLE
properties.summary: A Boolean value that indicates whether the advertising event type is connectable.
properties.description: The value for this key is an Number object. You can use this value to determine whether your app can currently connect to a peripheral.

properties.name: ADVERT_DATA_KEY_LOCAL_NAME
properties.summary: The local name of a peripheral.
properties.description: The value associated with this key is an String.

properties.name: ADVERT_DATA_KEY_MANUFACTURER_DATA
properties.summary: The manufacturer data of a peripheral.
properties.description: The value associated with this key is an TiBuffer object.

properties.name: ADVERT_DATA_KEY_OVERFLOW_SERVICE_UUIDS
properties.summary: An array of UUIDs found in the overflow area of the advertisement data.
properties.description:
The value associated with this key is an array of one or more String objects, representing Service UUIDs.
Because data stored in this area results from not fitting in the main advertisement, UUIDs listed here are “best effort” and may not always be accurate. For details about the overflow area of advertisement data, see the startAdvertising(_:) method in PeripheralManager.

properties.name: ADVERT_DATA_KEY_SERVICE_DATA
properties.summary: A dictionary that contains service-specific advertisement data.
properties.description: The keys (Strings objects) represent Service UUIDs, and the values (TiBuffer objects) represent service-specific data.

properties.name: ADVERT_DATA_KEY_SERVICE_UUIDS
properties.summary: An array of service UUIDs.
properties.description: The value associated with this key is an Array[String](api:Global.String) object.

properties.name: ADVERT_DATA_KEY_SOLICITED_SERVICE_UUIDS
properties.summary: An array of solicited service UUIDs.
properties.description: The value associated with this key is an array of one or more String objects, representing Service UUIDs.

properties.name: ADVERT_DATA_KEY_TX_POWER_LEVEL
properties.summary: The transmit power of a peripheral.
properties.description:
The value associated with this key is an instance of Number.
This key and value are available if the peripheral provides its transmitting power level in its advertising packet. You can calculate the path loss by comparing the RSSI value with the transmitting power level.

properties.name: CONNECT_PERIPHERAL_OPTIONS_KEY_ENABLE_TRANSPORT_BRIDGING
properties.summary: An option to bridge classic Bluetooth technology profiles, if already connected over Bluetooth Low Energy.
properties.description:
options object key used in Modules.BLE.CentralManager.connectPeripheral.
This option tells the system to connect non-GATT profiles on classic Bluetooth devices, if there is a low energy GATT connection to the same device.
A true value instructs the system to bring up classic transport profiles when a low energy transport peripheral connects. A false value tells the system not to use the profiles.

properties.name: CONNECT_PERIPHERAL_OPTIONS_KEY_NOTIFY_ON_CONNECTION
properties.summary: A Boolean value that specifies whether the system should display an alert when connecting a peripheral in the background.
properties.description:
options object key used in Modules.BLE.CentralManager.connectPeripheral.
The value for this key is an Boolean. This key is useful for apps that haven’t specified the bluetooth-central background mode and can’t display their own alert. 
If more than one app requests a notification for a given peripheral, the one that was most recently in the foreground receives the alert. If the key isn’t specified,
the default value is false.

properties.name: CONNECT_PERIPHERAL_OPTIONS_KEY_NOTIFY_ON_DISCONNECTION
properties.summary: A Boolean value that specifies whether the system should display an alert when disconnecting a peripheral in the background.
properties.description:
options object key used in Modules.BLE.CentralManager.connectPeripheral.
The value for this key is an Boolean. This key is useful for apps that haven’t specified the bluetooth-central background mode and can’t display their own alert. 
If more than one app requests a notification for a given peripheral, the one that was most recently in the foreground receives the alert. If the key isn’t specified,
the default value is false.

properties.name: CONNECT_PERIPHERAL_OPTIONS_KEY_NOTIFY_ON_NOTIFICATION
properties.summary: A Boolean value that specifies whether the system should display an alert for any notification sent by a peripheral.
properties.description:
options object key used in Modules.BLE.CentralManager.connectPeripheral.
If true, the system displays an alert for all notifications received from a given peripheral while the app is suspended.
the default value is false.

properties.name: CONNECT_PERIPHERAL_OPTIONS_KEY_REQUIRES_ANCS

properties.name: CONNECT_PERIPHERAL_OPTIONS_KEY_START_DELAY

methods.name: disable
methods.description:
This method requires bluetooth permissions to successfully work. To check
whether these permissions are granted or not, call
[isBluetoothAndBluetoothAdminPermissionsGranted](api:Modules.BLE#isBluetoothAndBluetoothAdminPermissionsGranted) method.
Listen for the [didUpdateState](Modules.BLE.didUpdateState) event to be notified when the local
Bluetooth adapter is turning off.

returns.summary: Returns true if the process is initiated successfully or when the bluetooth is already off.

methods.name: enable
methods.description:
This method requires bluetooth permissions to successfully work. To check
whether these permissions are granted or not, call
[isBluetoothAndBluetoothAdminPermissionsGranted](api:Modules.BLE#isBluetoothAndBluetoothAdminPermissionsGranted) method.
Listen for the [didUpdateState](Modules.BLE.didUpdateState) event to be notified when the local
Bluetooth adapter is turning on.

returns.summary: Returns true if the process is initiated successfully or when the bluetooth is already on.

parameters.name: showPowerAlert
parameters.summary: A Boolean value that specifies whether the system warns the user if the app instantiates the central manager when Bluetooth service isn’t available.

parameters.name: restoreIdentifier

methods.name: initPeripheralManager

parameters.name: restoreIdentifier

methods.name: isBluetoothAndBluetoothAdminPermissionsGranted
methods.summary: Determines if bluetooth permissions have been granted.
methods.description:
If this method returns `false`, then you'll need to call the
[requestPermissions](api:Modules.BLE#requestPermissions) method to request these permissions from the user.

returns.summary: Returns true if bluetooth permissions have been granted

methods.name: isEnabled

methods.name: isSupported

methods.name: requestPermissions
methods.summary: Displays a dialog requesting bluetooth permissions from the user.
methods.description:
Displays a dialog requesting the `BLUETOOTH_ADVERTISE`, `BLUETOOTH_CONNECT`, and `BLUETOOTH_SCAN` permissions
if running on Android 12 or higher. These permission are required by this module to
discover devices and to make the app's device discoverable by other devices. On older Android OS versions,
a dialog will not be displayed and will instead check if permissions `BLUETOOTH` and `BLUETOOTH_ADMIN`
are defined in the app's manifest.

The given optional callback argument and returned `Promise` will provide a `success` property
indicating if permissions were granted or not.

A dialog will not be displayed if permissions have already been granted and will immediately invoke
the optional callback and returned promise with a success result.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.summary: Function to be invoked indicating if permissions were granted or not.

returns.summary: Returns a `Promise` whose resolved value is equivalent to that passed to the optional callback argument.
